title: Law to widen hours for sidewalk cleanliness fines on businesses
summary: This bill would let the Department of Sanitation fine businesses for dirty sidewalks any time during their posted hours of operation, as long as those hours are visibly posted and the business is open to the public. Other commercial premises could still be fined only between 8:00 a.m. and 7:00 p.m. The law would take effect 120 days after being enacted.
